posts.name: SUDHEE RAM
posts.cooked:
Respected sir, when i am typing ssh-keygen command in my windows powershell i am getting the following,

Screenshot (562)1472×159 7.34 KB

Can we use the public key that we have already created using ssh-keygen command when we were trying to access course VM(at the beginning of the course) OR should we create the public key again this time?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Your should not overwrite the key as it will revoke the access to the course vm and you will have to again share your public key instead use the existing key and submit it to the oppe vm portal.

posts.name: SUDHEE RAM
posts.cooked: thank you very much for the clarification, sir.
